description_en: Queries the log collection status (whether log collection is enabled) of domain names that are added to WAF for protection
description_zh: 查询已接入WAF进行防护的域名的日志采集状态（是否开启日志采集）
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-log-service-status --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call DescribeInstanceInfo to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用DescribeInstanceInfo查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of Log Service. Valid values: 
cn: the Chinese mainland (default)
cn-hongkong: outside China
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务地域ID。取值： 
cn：中国内地地区（默认）
cn-hongkong：海外地区
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The list of domain names to query. You can specify up to 10 domain names at a time. If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html to query all domain names that are added to the current WAF instance for protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名列表。一次最多允许查询10个域名。不填写该参数表示查询所有域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html查询所有已经接入当前WAF实例进行防护的域名
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

DomainStatus.description_en: The log collection status of the domain names (whether log collection is enabled)
DomainStatus.description_zh: 域名的日志采集状态（是否开启了日志采集）

SlsLogActive.description_en:
Indicates whether log collection is enabled for the domain name. Valid values:

1: enabled.
0: disabled
SlsLogActive.description_zh:
该域名是否开启了日志采集。取值：

1：表示已开启。
0：表示未开启

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
